tasks.title: Enforce maxConcurrentAgents in startPipeline and add field to getStatus
tasks.description: In agent-runner-service.ts: (1) Add `activeAgents.size >= this.maxConcurrentAgents` check in `startPipeline()` after the existing `activeAgents.has(issue.id)` check, returning `{ started: false, error: 'Concurrent agent limit reached (N)' }`. (2) Add `maxConcurrentAgents: this.maxConcurrentAgents` field to `getStatus()` return object. (3) Update the backend `AgentStatus` interface to include the new field.
acceptanceCriteria: startPipeline() rejects with error when activeAgents.size >= maxConcurrentAgents
startPipeline() allows start when activeAgents.size < maxConcurrentAgents
getStatus() returns maxConcurrentAgents field with the configured value
AgentStatus interface includes maxConcurrentAgents: number
cd packages/cli && npm run build succeeds
tasks.notes: The maxConcurrentAgents field is already stored in the class (line 53) and logged (line 68), just never checked in startPipeline.

tasks.title: Add 429 response for concurrent limit in start API handler
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Start handler 校验 issue status
tasks.description: In packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts POST /:number/start handler AND packages/cli/src/api/propose.ts POST /:number/propose handler: add a check before calling startPipeline that compares agentRunner.getStatus().activeAgents.length >= agentRunner.getMaxConcurrentAgents(). If exceeded, return 429 with error message 'Concurrent agent limit reached (N)'. This gives proper HTTP semantics separate from the 409 already-running check.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues/:number/start returns 429 when concurrent limit reached
POST /api/issues/:number/propose returns 429 when concurrent limit reached
Error response includes the limit value in the message
POST /api/issues/:number/start returns 409 when issue already running (existing behavior preserved)
POST /api/issues/:number/start returns 200 when under capacity (existing behavior preserved)
cd packages/cli && npm run build succeeds
tasks.notes: The 429 check should go after the existing isRunning check (line 347-353) and before the startPipeline call (line 366).
